verses.en: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.pt: Não te alegres tanto, ó Israel, como os outros povos, pois tu te prostituis, afastando-te de teu Deus; tu amas o salário de prostituta em todas as eiras de trigo.
verses.en_web: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
verses.en_bbe: Have no joy, O Israel, and do not be glad like the nations; for you have been untrue to your God; your desire has been for the loose woman's reward on every grain-floor.

verses.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.pt: A eira e a prensa de uvas não os manterão; e o vinho novo lhes faltará.
verses.en_web: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
verses.en_bbe: The grain-floor and the place where the grapes are crushed will not give them food; there will be no new wine for them.

verses.en: They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.pt: Não permanecerão na terra do SENHOR; em vez disso, Efraim voltará ao Egito, e na Assíria comerão coisa imunda.
verses.en_web: They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.en_bbe: They will have no resting-place in the Lord's land, but Ephraim will go back to Egypt, and they will take unclean food in Assyria.

verses.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Não derramarão ofertas de bebida ao SENHOR, nem seus sacrifícios lhe serão agradáveis; seu pão será para eles como pão de lamento; todos os que comerem dele, serão imundos; porque o pão deles será para saciar sua própria fome, e não virá para a casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into Yahweh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: They will give no wine offering to the Lord, they will not make offerings ready for him; their bread will be like the bread of those in sorrow; all who take it will be unclean, because their bread will be only for their desire, it will not come into the house of the Lord.

verses.en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.pt: Que fareis no dia solene, no dia festa do SENHOR?
verses.en_web: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?
verses.en_bbe: What will you do on the day of worship, and on the day of the feast of the Lord?

verses.en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.pt: Porque eis que eles vão embora por causa da destruição; o Egito os recolherá, Mênfis os sepultará; urtigas herdarão sua prata, espinhos crescerão em suas tendas.
verses.en_web: For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
verses.en_bbe: For see, they are going away into Assyria; Egypt will get them together, Memphis will be their last resting-place; their fair silver vessels will be covered over with field plants, and thorns will come up in their tents.

verses.en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.pt: Chegaram os dias da punição, chegaram os dias da retribuição; os israelitas saberão; o profeta é considerado louco, o homem espiritual é visto como tolo, por causa da grandeza de tua maldade e do grande ódio.
verses.en_web: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
verses.en_bbe: The days of punishment, the days of reward are come; Israel will be put to shame; the prophet is foolish, the man who has the spirit is off his head, because of your great sin.

verses.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
verses.pt: O profeta é um guarda de Efraim para meu Deus; mas para ele há laços de caçador em todos os seus caminhos, e ódio na casa de seu Deus.
verses.en_web: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
verses.en_bbe: There is great hate against the watchman of Ephraim, the people of my God; as for the prophet, there is a net in all his ways, and hate in the house of his God.

verses.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.pt: Corromperam-se profundamente, como nos dias de Gibeá: Deus se lembrará de suas perversidades, seus pecados punirá.
verses.en_web: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
verses.en_bbe: They have gone deep in evil as in the days of Gibeah; he will keep in mind their wrongdoing, he will give them punishment for their sins.

verses.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.pt: Eu achei a Israel como uvas no deserto; eu vi a vossos pais como a primeira fruta da figueira em seu princípio. Porém eles foram a Baal-Peor, dedicaram-se a esta vergonha, e se tornaram tão abomináveis quanto aquilo que amaram.
verses.en_web: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
verses.en_bbe: I made discovery of Israel as of grapes in the waste land; I saw your fathers as the first-fruits of the fig-tree in her early fruit time; but they came to Baal-peor, and made themselves holy to the thing of shame, and became disgusting like that to which they gave their love.

verses.en: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.pt: A glória de Efraim voará como ave; não haverá nascimento, nem gravidez, nem concepção.
verses.en_web: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
verses.en_bbe: As for Ephraim, their glory will go in flight like a bird: there will be no birth and no one with child and no giving of life.

verses.en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.pt: Ainda que venham a criar seus filhos, contudo eu os privarei deles, de modo que reste nenhum. Ai deles quando deles eu me afastar!
verses.en_web: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.en_bbe: Even though their children have come to growth I will take them away, so that not a man will be there; for their evil-doing will be complete and they will be put to shame because of it.

verses.en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.pt: Vi que Efraim era como Tiro, plantada num lugar agradável; mas Efraim trará seus filhos ao matador.
verses.en_web: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
verses.en_bbe: As I have seen a beast whose young have been taken from her, so Ephraim will give birth to children only for them to be put to death.

verses.en: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.pt: Dá-lhes, SENHOR, o que lhes darás? Dá-lhes ventre que aborte, e seios sem leite.
verses.en_web: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, what will you give them? Give them bodies which may not give birth and breasts without milk.

verses.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.pt: Por causa de toda a sua malícia em Gilgal, ali eu os odiei; por causa da malícia de suas obras eu os expulsarei de minha casa; eu não mais os amarei; todos os seus príncipes são rebeldes.
verses.en_web: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
verses.en_bbe: All their evil-doing is in Gilgal; there I had hate for them; because of their evil-doing I will send them out of my house; they will no longer be dear to me; all their rulers are uncontrolled.

verses.en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.pt: Efraim foi ferido, sua raiz se secou, não darão fruto; e que ainda que gerem, eu matarei os desejáveis frutos de seu ventre.
verses.en_web: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
verses.en_bbe: The rod has come on Ephraim, their root is dry, let them have no fruit; even though they give birth, I will put to death the dearest fruit of their bodies.

verses.en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.pt: Meu Deus os rejeitará porque não o ouviram; e andarão sem rumo entre as nações.
verses.en_web: My God will cast them away, because they did not listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.en_bbe: My God will give them up because they did not give ear to him; they will be wandering among the nations.
